post.description: Takes `quantity` pieces (default 1) with one code, within the offer's `maxPerUser`. LIMITED offers hold them until `expiresAt` (our hold time, or the offer's end if sooner). A customer can hold 3 reservations at once (409 "TooManyReservations"), and after cancelling an offer 2 times can't book it again (409 "CancelledTooOften"). 3 missed pickups within 30 days pause booking for 3 days, 7 if paused lately (403 "ClaimBanned"). UNLIMITED offers just give a code valid until the offer ends.
